historia.texto: A banda tocou I Want You So Hard, do Eagles of Death Metal, que estava no palco do Bataclan no dia dos atentados de Paris. Em espanhol, o Eddie dedicou Sirens ao Fernando, fã que morreu aos 25 anos e cuja família estava na plateia. No bis, viu uma fã com uma bandeira escrita Faithfull, mudou o setlist e desceu pra cantar a música cara a cara com ela na grade. Enquanto preparavam a guitarra, apresentou o Legs, câmera da equipe, que estava na estrada havia 28 anos e fazia ali o último show. No segundo intervalo, uma cortina preta escondeu o público enquanto o Eddie gravava um vídeo com o Legs. Quando ela caiu, a plateia apareceu e a banda inteira foi cumprimentar o Legs, que ficou emocionado. Ainda teve parabéns pro Matt e um bolo arremessado pro público.
historia.rotuloFonte: Fanviews do fórum oficial do Pearl Jam

fontes.trecho: Want You So Hard (Bad Boy News)-(Hughes, Homme) Eagles Of Death Metal cover. The band was playing a show in Paris at Le Bataclan when it was attacked by terrorists on November 13.
speaking in Spanish Ed conveys that this song is Fernando.  Fernando was a fan of the band and sadly passed away at 25 years old.  His family is in the audience in his honor.
Ed spots a woman holding a flag with the word “Faithfull" written on it.
Faithfull.  (Ed goes down to the barricade and sings Faithfull face to face to  the woman that had requested the song.)

Ed says that since they are changing the set list it will take them some time to build a guitar so meanwhile he asks for a light on the stage right cameraman.  “His name is Legs and he has been touring for 28 years and this is his very last night.

Two crew members hold up a black curtain.  On the other side out of the audience view Ed has his arm around Legs the cameraman and is video recording a message.  He says, “who else is here” and the curtain drops to reveal the audience.  The entire band come over and congratulate Legs who is visibly moved.
It is also Matt’s birthday and the band and audience sing “happy birthday” to him.
A cake is brought out but rather than smashing it on the person celebrating their birthday they decide to throw the cake in the audience.
